title: Chat Assistant
name: Assistant Name
empty_response_desc: If no relevant content is found in the knowledge base, this will be used as the answer. Leave blank to let the LLM provide its own opinion.
opener_desc: Set the assistant's opening message to guide the conversation.
show_quote_desc: Should the original source be displayed?
prompt_desc: System prompt sets the assistant's behavior and response style.
similarity_threshold_desc: Hybrid similarity score threshold for filtering chunks. Default is 0.2.
vector_similarity_weight_desc: Weight for vector cosine similarity in the hybrid scoring. Sum with keyword similarity weight equals 1.0.
top_n_desc: Only these 'Top N' chunks above the similarity threshold will be provided to the LLM.
top_p_desc: Also known as 'nucleus sampling', sets a threshold to select a smaller set of words for sampling.
temperature_desc: Controls the randomness of model predictions. Lower values make responses more confident, higher values more creative.
